notes: Flux: chart and source versions in 1 file under kubernetes/ (for example kubernetes/flux/podinfo.yaml).
Argo CD: the charts and images of Applications in 1 file under kubernetes/ (for example kubernetes/argocd/web.yaml).
Kubernetes: container images in 1 file under kubernetes/ (for example kubernetes/apps/web/deploy.yaml).
Helm charts and values files are covered by the bot's defaults: 1 file under kubernetes/ (for example kubernetes/charts/web/Chart.yaml).
Talos and Kubernetes versions in talos/talconfig.yaml, from their stable GitHub releases.
Talos installer images from the Image Factory in 1 file under talos/ (for example talos/patches/install.yaml).
Patch updates are grouped into one pull request per manager; no schedule and no automerge: you decide on the forge.
After merging, install the Renovate GitHub app on this repository (github.com/apps/renovate): it opens its update pull requests from there.
Files encrypted with SOPS are not touched by the managers above.
